name: Teachable
summary: Course and coaching platform for creators: build and sell courses, coaching, digital downloads and memberships with a built-in checkout, tax handling and iOS and Android student apps.
best_for: course creators and coaches who sell to their own audience and want checkout, tax handling and student apps handled for them
skip_if: you mainly give courses away for free or import large student lists, or you want a free plan to start on
honest_knock: Starter takes 7.5% of every sale on top of the $39 plan, and payment processing is extra on every plan, so the plan price is not what you pay. Students you import, enroll by hand or give free access count against an allowance of 100 per school and then cost $0.50 a month each. Refunds need a written request within 30 days, after you cancel the plan yourself. Student subscriptions may keep charging for up to 30 days after your school plan ends.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-02 on teachable.com/pricing, teachable.com/legal/usage-fees and Teachable's help article on transaction fees and bundles; the pricing page says all prices are in US dollars) Teachable has three self-serve plans and a Custom plan. Starter is $39 a month billed monthly, or $29 a month billed annually: 5 published products, 1 admin and a 7.5% transaction fee on your sales. Builder is $89 a month, or $69 billed annually: 10 products, 1 admin, a 0% transaction fee when you use Teachable Payments, an affiliate program and real-time support. Growth is $189 a month, or $139 billed annually: 50 products, 5 admins, course certificates, Teachable branding removed, imported students and custom admin permissions. Custom is priced through sales. Every plan includes up to 1TB of video storage; beyond that the usage-fee page lists $15 a month per additional TB. Payment processing comes on top of the plan: for a US school the base rate is 2.9% + $0.30 per domestic card and 4.4% + $0.30 per international card. On the default Standard bundle Teachable adds 0.5% where tax is assessed and 0.7% on recurring transactions; the optional Global bundle adds 2.8% on all transactions instead. Students added outside Teachable checkout (imports, the API, manual enrollment, $0 or 100%-coupon checkouts) are free up to 100 per school, then $0.50 a month per student. There is no free plan: the pricing page offers a 7-day free trial and a 30-day guarantee.

compare_with.name: LearnWorlds
compare_with.why: both sell courses with a built-in checkout. LearnWorlds puts more weight on interactive video, assessments and a branded school site; Teachable's plans are built around a product limit and a transaction fee that only Starter pays. Compare the fee you would pay on your expected sales, not just the plan price
